title: get api health returns status ok
description: Verify that a GET request to /api/health returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {"status":"ok"} indicating the API is operational.

title: post api auth registro with valid data creates usuario role user
description: Test POST /api/auth/registro with valid nombre, unique email, and strong password creates a user with role "usuario" and returns HTTP 201 with token and user data.

title: post api auth registro with weak password returns validation error
description: Test POST /api/auth/registro with a password that does not meet complexity rules returns HTTP 400 with appropriate validation error messages.

title: post api auth login with valid credentials returns token and usuario
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with correct email and password returns HTTP 200 with JWT token and user data.

title: post api auth login with invalid credentials returns 401 error
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with unknown email or wrong password returns HTTP 401 with message "Credenciales inválidas".

title: get api auth perfil with valid token returns authenticated user
description: Test GET /api/auth/perfil with valid x-token header returns HTTP 200 with authenticated user's profile data.

title: put api auth perfil updates nombre and email with uniqueness check
description: Test PUT /api/auth/perfil with valid x-token and updated nombre and/or email updates the user profile, ensuring email uniqueness except for the user's own email, returning HTTP 200 with updated user.

title: put api auth password changes password with correct current password
description: Test PUT /api/auth/password with valid x-token, correct current password, and valid new password different from current updates the password and returns HTTP 200 with confirmation message.

title: get api usuarios with admin token returns paginated user list
description: Test GET /api/usuarios with valid admin x-token returns HTTP 200 with paginated list of active users, supporting optional search, role filter, page, and limit parameters.

title: delete api usuarios id with admin token logically deletes user except self
description: Test DELETE /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token deletes the specified user logically (estado=false) and returns HTTP 200 with confirmation, but returns HTTP 400 if admin attempts to delete own account.
